text: よるに　なると　２ほんの　ねっこで　３００メートルも　あるくという。

structure.jp: ３００メートルも　あるくという。
structure.en: it is said to walk as far as 300 meters.

patterns.name: 〜という
patterns.explanation: という at the end of a sentence means 'they say', for things known by hearsay. あるくという = 'it is said to walk'.

patterns.name: 〜と (whenever)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb means 'whenever this happens, that always follows'. よるに なると = 'when night comes'.

patterns.name: 〜も (as much as)
patterns.explanation: も after an amount shows the speaker finds it a lot. ３００メートルも = 'as far as 300 meters'.
